_comment: Project-shared Claude Code settings. Adopted 2026-05-15 from /insights friction analysis. User-only overrides live in settings.local.json. Existing .claude/hooks/pre_tool_use.py (DamageControlValidator + delegation injection) runs independently — DO NOT remove.

hooks.description: RQ-220 pre-send verification — deterministic rule-corpus check on outbound-shaped Bash commands. Returns 1 to block, 0 to allow. Skips silently if command doesn't match outbound shape.

RQ-228 Cat 2 pre-token-budget hook — projects $ cost of any Bash command invoking an LLM (claude -p / curl api.anthropic.com / nano-agent / etc) vs daily running total in budget_tracking.db. Warn-only per operator decision 2026-05-17 — never blocks, always exits 0. Logs projected cost to .claude/token_budget_log.jsonl. Promotion to block-mode via Cat 11 (rule_lifecycle_manager.py) after 14d of data, requires TB_TOKEN_DAILY_CAP_USD=N + TB_TOKEN_BUDGET_MODE=block env.

hooks.command: for f in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do case "$f" in *.py) python3 -m py_compile "$f" 2>&1 | head -10 || true ;; esac; done
hooks.description: Run py_compile on Python edits — catches rename-but-missed-log-statement bugs. Advisory: prints errors but does not block.

hooks.command: for f in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS; do case "$f" in */SKILL.md) python3 /c/Users/noahm/Project/scripts/skill_quality_grader.py --only "$f" --no-usage 2>&1 | tail -4 || true ;; esac; done
hooks.description: Skill-QA rubric (Mnilax 3 properties: role line / output shape / termination) on SKILL.md edits. Body-level companion to doc-skill-frontmatter. Advisory warn-only — prints score, never blocks. Add --min-score to gate.
